role: frequency-ordered word list (seed-only language: the app bundles the whole list, nothing to download)
generationVersion: HKeyboard scripts/ThaiSegment.java (JDK 21.0.10 dictionary-based Thai BreakIterator) + gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (Batch 10 added the thai script)
generationCommand: java scripts/ThaiSegment.java tha_text.txt tha_seg.txt && python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang th --script thai --min-count 2 --stop "tom,mary,john,jim,mike,ken,sami,layla,jane,bill,bob,jack,maria,mari,ทอม,ท,อม,แมรี,แมรี่,จอห์น" --out th_words.txt tha_seg.txt
transformations: ThaiSegment.java: each sentence split into words by the JDK's dictionary-based Thai word BreakIterator (Thai writes no word spaces), written space-separated

gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Thai letters and their combining marks; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop, including the segmenter's fragments of Tom); words seen only once dropped (min-count 2); ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the whole list (1617 words at min-count 2); nothing is downloaded. Word boundaries are the segmenter's - a Thai speaker should review compounds.
